name: Davia Creation
description: Davia Creation lets creators build and revise private Davia game drafts with Claude. Choose one of your games, inspect its premise, rules, world stats, characters, places, and map placements, then make precise updates while preserving the structure of the world. Claude can add, edit, or remove entities and landmarks, update game rules and stats, and search across the draft before making changes. Access is limited to games owned by the authenticated Davia creator.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Davia Creation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Davia Creation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://tale-mcp-208104258932.us-east4.run.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Davia Creation MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Davia Creation provides these MCP tools: current_draft, edit_file, grep, list_drafts, list_files, read_file, and select_draft.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Davia Creation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Davia Creation in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.

_published_faq.name: Does Davia Creation MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Davia Creation requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Davia Creation is developed by Davia. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
